author: Kuba
text: The brewer sat with us for half an hour. The smoked lager was the surprise.

author: Anna
text: Six beers is a lot for two. Take the dinner option.

author: Lars
text: No booking, we showed the code and sat down.

author: Claire
text: Take the window table. The castle lit up right as the main course arrived.

author: Pavel
text: Food was good, not great. The view makes up for it.
reply: Thanks, Pavel. We have a new menu from October.

author: Julia
text: Be there twenty minutes early, they do leave on time.

author: Team Friday
text: We got out with four minutes left. The print-shop room is the one to pick.

author: Veronika
text: Did it with my parents. The hints are kind, not patronising.

author: Adam
text: Fun hour. Six in the room is tight.
reply: True, four or five is the sweet spot.

author: Emma
text: Messy and great. Mine looked nothing like theirs and tasted fine.

author: David R.
text: Went with two kids. They still talk about it.
reply: Come back for the Christmas class.

author: Lucie
text: Good class. Ninety minutes is enough.
